# NetSuite CPQ Guided Selling

NetSuite CPQ Guided Selling (16 pages): NetSuite CPQ Guided Selling

## Chapters
- [NetSuite CPQ Guided Selling](article_173345162.md): Note: NetSuite CPQ Guided Selling can work independently from NetSuite CPQ Configurator.
  - [NetSuite CPQ Guided Selling Setup](article_7173421493.md): Before creating catalogs, define settings on the options record at Guided Selling System Global Settings.
  - [Creating Catalogs](article_2180226163.md): Note: Catalogs are called products on the user interface.
  - [Searching for Items from Transactions](article_2175306878.md): Users can open catalogs from eligible transactions.
